{{Quote|The Rebels are flying in a diplomat named Darmin Lerspri, supposedly an Alderaanian official of some sort who happened to be off world when it was destroyed.|[[Prisk Kith'Vys]], to an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:ETRDDM" />}}
'''Darmin Lerspri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Darmin will be travelling in a YT-1300 named the 'Nerfs Pride', and will likely have an armed escort.''"<br />"'''Nerfs Pride'?''"<br />"''Apparently he was some sort of nerf herder on his native Alderaan.|Prisk Kith'Vys and an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:ETRDDM" />}}
Darmin Lerspri used to serve as an official on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], while also being a [[Nerf herder/Legends|nerf herder]]. Fortunately, he was off world when the the planet was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and survived the cataclysm. Lerspri therefore joined actively the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a diplomat.<ref name="SWG:ETRDDM" />

[[File:Nerfs_Pride.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''[[Nerfs Pride]]'', just before its destruction.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Lerspri undertook a mission to the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in order to convince the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] government to support the Rebellion in the war against the Empire. However, his ship, the ''[[Nerfs Pride]]'', was attacked in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] by Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] led by [[Prisk Kith'Vys]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] special unit [[Black Epsilon]] eventually destroyed the ship, thereby killing Darmin Lerspri before he could land on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:ETRDDM" />
